title: Step Order Configuration
description: Defines the strict waterfall dependency DAG, pipeline policies, and downstream consumer mappings for the spec-driven development workflow.

version.description: Semantic version of the step_order configuration format.

_notes.description: Human-readable documentation notes explaining design decisions. Not consumed by tooling.

policy.description: Pipeline execution policy governing dependency resolution and replay behavior.

mode.description: Pipeline execution mode. Currently only 'strict_waterfall' is supported.

allow_self_dependency.description: Whether a step is permitted to list itself as its own dependency.

allow_forward_dependency.description: Whether a step may depend on a step that appears later in the pipeline ordering.

require_full_forward_replay_on_change.description: When true, any upstream change requires full replay of all downstream steps.

status_write_exemptions.description: Maps step IDs to arrays of JSON path patterns that are exempt from triggering forward replay. Prevents infinite replay cycles for status-only writes.

items.description: A JSON path pattern exempt from replay (e.g., '$.milestones[*].status').

additionalProperties.description: Array of JSON path patterns exempt from triggering forward replay for this step.

steps.description: Ordered list of step IDs defining the strict waterfall sequence. Position determines dependency eligibility.

items.description: Step identifier: two-digit number optionally followed by a single lowercase letter suffix (a, b, or c).

coverage_thresholds.description: Thresholds governing traceability coverage requirements for the spec pipeline.

fr_coverage.description: Minimum percentage of functional requirements that must be traced to downstream artifacts.

mode.description: Whether coverage threshold violations produce warnings or hard errors.

downstream_consumers.description: Maps each step ID to the list of steps that actively consume its output. Used by 'specdev prompt-context' to surface relevant upstream artifacts. NOT used by forward-replay checks.

items.description: A step ID (two-digit, optionally with letter suffix) that consumes this step's output.

additionalProperties.description: Array of step IDs that consume output from this step.

step_metadata.description: Per-step declarative metadata: upstream spec inputs and seed inputs. Optional — when present, the consistency linter validates each declared field against the inverse of downstream_consumers (required_spec_inputs) or seed_manifest.step_requirements (required_seed_inputs). Both inner fields are independently optional so a step may opt in to one side without the other; the linter treats omitted fields as empty lists and still catches missing edges via the cross-source comparison.

additionalProperties.description: Metadata block for a single step. Both inner fields are optional to allow incremental per-step migration; the linter validates whatever is declared and treats absence as an empty list. Keys at this level must reference steps declared in the top-level `steps` array — phantom step keys are caught by `_lint_step_metadata_consistency` (E543).

required_spec_inputs.description: Step IDs whose output this step ingests as input. Must match the inverse of downstream_consumers (a step is listed here iff the producer lists this step in its downstream_consumers). Optional — when omitted, the linter treats this side as empty and surfaces any missing edge via E543.

items.description: A step ID that produces upstream input for this step.

required_seed_inputs.description: Seed document IDs required by this step. Must match a subset of seed_manifest.seeds[*].seed_id and should mirror seed_manifest.step_requirements[<this step>] when present. Optional — when omitted, the linter treats this side as empty and surfaces any missing seed edge via E543.
